incident: Duplicate social publication from concurrent publisher runs
symptom: The same canonical social artifact could be published twice when two runs observed content_ready before either persisted provider delivery state.
root_cause: Non-atomic read-then-side-effect sequencing around powerhouse_channel_decisions allowed concurrent writers to cross the external provider boundary.
prevention: Atomically compare-and-set content_ready to dispatching before every external provider write.
Only the run that wins the claim may call Composio, Buffer, or another provider.
A claim loser exits ALREADY_CLAIMED_OR_DELIVERED without regeneration or replacement.
Retry only when evidence proves the previous attempt did not cross the provider side-effect boundary; otherwise reconcile provider truth first.
Keep provider readback/external_id mandatory before treating delivery as covered.
discovered_gate_repairs: Correct PR machine metadata to allowed delivery lane/candidate type/exact Base-SHA.
Terminate 20260917235907 reconciler function with semicolon before revoke.
Align ffmpeg-static regression assertion with repository version 5.3.0.
terminal_rule: Do not claim LIVE_BEWEZEN until exact-head required gates, protected merge/promotion, and production/provider readback are proven.
